activity_on_chain.description: Cache of ActivityNFT data minted on the OGCR chain (chain id 2025). One record per activity_id, populated by OGCR-chain-cache reading the chain.

activity_id.description: Links to the `activity` dynamic entity. The on-chain ActivityNFT is keyed by this id.

token_id.description: ActivityNFT token id minted for this activity.

start_date.description: Activity start date as stored on-chain.

end_date.description: Activity end date as stored on-chain.

activity_url.description: activity_url stored on-chain: link back to the OBP activity entity.

activity_hash.description: activity_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw activity entity body.

owner_address.description: Current owner of the NFT (operator OGCR wallet address).

token_uri.description: tokenURI of the NFT (ERC721 metadata data-URI).

contract_address.description: ActivityNFT contract address the token was read from.

tx_hash.description: Mint transaction hash (from the ActivityMinted event).

block_number.description: Block number the mint was included in.
